title: Enceladus global surface map for three-sided zorb projection

sources.title: Enceladus Cassini Global Mosaic 100m Schenk
sources.credit: NASA/Cassini ISS; Paul M. Schenk and William B. McKinnon, Lunar and Planetary Institute/USRA; Planetary Data System; USGS Astrogeology Science Center

projection.name: Equirectangular
projection.verification: USGS record and linked PDS4 label agree on positive-east longitude, 0 to 360 extent, planetocentric latitude and central meridian 180; the unannotated JPEG is the record's 2:1 sample of that product.

sources.interpretation: Cassini-derived rectified grayscale mosaic, not an invented moon texture or natural-color photograph. The 100 m scale names the full scientific raster; this unchanged 1024 by 512 browse JPEG has lower resolution.
sources.reuse_notes: Publicly downloadable NASA mission data product published through PDS and USGS. No asset-specific copyright notice or license appears in the source record or linked PDS4 label; retain the scientific credit. No blanket CC0 license or NASA endorsement is asserted.
